title: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline on the Evaluation and Care of Living Kidney Donors

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline on the Evaluation and Care of Living Kidney Donors》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The 2017 Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) Clinical Practice Guideline on the Evaluation and Care of Living Kidney Donors is intended to assist medical professionals who evaluate living kidney donor candidates and provide care before, during and after donation.
